title: Arthur Young, Puharich and the seances with the Nine

tellings.quote: Booharic as well and he was involved in some of those seances with the nine

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that an inventor named Arthur Young and a researcher named Andrija Puharich took part in séances, sessions meant to contact unseen beings, with a group that called itself the Nine. According to Michels, this went on in the United States sometime between the 1950s and the 1970s, and he tells it as a case of serious people trying to talk with a non-human intelligence.
